notes: The author's name is corrupt. 'varadarāha' is read as Varadarāja, the known author of the Madhyasiddhāntakaumudī. The prefix 'caviṭikaṃṭi' is unexplained and probably corrupt (perhaps a garbled epithet or place name), so it is not recorded as an affiliation. The colophon has no date, place, or copyist. The catalogue gives the scribe as 'Pūrṇacandra Paṇḍita Upādhyāya Bhaṭṭarāī', but the quoted colophon does not name him. He may appear elsewhere in the manuscript, so check the catalogue entry or images before adding him.
